_note: Street, ownership, events, regulation, critiques, gaps and conflicts as of 30-Sep-2026. Notes published after 30-Sep-2026 are excluded (see updates/later-facts.json).

street._method: Brokers that disclose a method value Poonawalla on P/B on FY28E (Mar-28E) book: Motilal Oswal 3.0x, Deven Choksey 3.2x adjusted book, JM Financial 2.2x, Emkay 1.9x; HDFC Securities uses residual income (implying 1.9x Mar-28 adjusted book).

brokers.thesis: Raised from ₹610 after Q1FY27; Feb-2026 note: ROA to 2% by FY28, value at 2.4x FY27E P/B; risks: delayed equity raise, weaker asset quality
ROE from mid-single digits to 16.8% in FY28E; PAT ₹1,540 cr / ₹2,626 cr FY27-28E; assumes ~30% AUM growth
~43% AUM CAGR and ~116% PAT CAGR FY26-28E; ROA/ROE 2.4%/16.5% in FY28E; NIM 7.6-7.7%; credit cost 2.2%/1.9% (17-Jul, reiterated 10-Aug)
Raised from ₹490 (initiation) after Q1FY27; thesis: HDFC-style leadership overhaul under Arvind Kapil, fastest AUM growth among large NBFCs
n.d. (May-2026 note: 3.2x FY27E book, ROE ~12-13% to FY28E after the QIP)
Strong growth and stable asset quality, but valuation; builds in another ₹3,000 cr equity raise in FY28E at ₹450
Expensive at 2.4x FY28E book for ~13.7% average ROE FY26-28E; assignment income unsustainable; ECL coverage thin for a 46% unsecured, unseasoned book
Credit cost ~2.5% annualised (write-offs 2.1%); ROE ~12% by FY28E; 2.5x Mar-28 ABV leaves little margin of safety
n.d. in the sources we saw (Q4FY26 note; no later note found by 30-Sep)

mosl.note: PAT in ₹ mn; no further equity raise; assets ÷ equity 7.5x in FY28E

deven.src: DSIJ summary of the Deven Choksey note

events.title: Rising Sun (Adar Poonawalla) takes control of Magma Fincorp
events.detail: Preferential issue of 49.37 cr shares at ₹70 (₹3,456 cr), ~60% to Rising Sun; approved at the EGM of 9-Mar-2021; renamed Poonawalla Fincorp.

events.title: MD Abhay Bhutada resigns after a SEBI interim insider-trading order; reinstated Feb-2022
events.detail: SEBI revoked the interim order against him in Jun-2022.

events.title: Housing finance arm sold to TPG at a ₹3,900 cr valuation
events.detail: Announced Dec-2022; gain of ₹2,308.97 cr in FY24, used alongside a one-time ₹1,298.31 cr provision and ₹174.95 cr write-off on the legacy Magma book (net exceptional ₹816.52 cr).

events.title: Long-term guidance: AUM +35-40%, ROA 4-4.5%
events.detail: FY24 ROA was 5.7% (Q4 annualised) on provision write-backs; this guidance was not met.

events.title: Arvind Kapil (ex-HDFC Bank) becomes MD & CEO
events.detail: Abhay Bhutada took early retirement as MD on 9-Jun-2024.

events.title: Q2FY25: loss of ₹471 cr on a ₹666 cr accelerated provision on the short-ticket personal loan (STPL) book
events.detail: STPL was 21% of on-book AUM in Sep-2024, 8% by Mar-2025; ₹520 cr of STPL write-offs in Q3FY25; FY25 net loss ₹98 cr.

events.title: ₹1,500 cr preferential issue to the promoter at ₹452.51
events.detail: 3.31 cr shares to Rising Sun Holdings; promoter stake to ~64%.

events.title: Board takes a 12-month enabling approval to raise up to ₹5,500 cr of equity
₹2,500 cr QIP at ₹370.75
events.detail: 6.74 cr shares (floor ₹390.26, 5% discount); promoter stake 63.9% → 59.0%; debt-to-equity 4.67x → 3.82x.

events.title: Q1FY27: PAT ₹308 cr (+21% QoQ), ROA 1.98%, AUM +62.5%
events.detail: Credit cost 2.40%, GNPA 1.37%, opex/AUM 4.06%; ROA target 3-3.5% by a 'June exit of 2028'.

market.detail: September 2026 sell-off: Nifty and Sensex down ~5% for the month by 28-Sep on foreign selling, Brent ~$106 and US 10-year yields at 5.2%; listed NBFCs fell 4-16% between 31-Jul and 30-Sep. Poonawalla closed at ₹443.85 on 30-Sep (₹477 on 17-Jul).

regulatory.riskWeights: RBI raised risk weights on unsecured consumer credit to 125% in Nov-2023; the extra weight on bank loans to NBFCs was reversed from Apr-2025.
regulatory.revolvingCredit: RBI draft (6-Aug-2026) barring NBFCs from revolving credit: Poonawalla discloses no revolving loan book; it has launched a 'PFIN EMI card' for consumer durables (Q1FY27 call), and whether the draft would cover it is not clear from our sources. The whole consumer durable book is ₹580 cr (<1% of AUM), so not material in our reading.
regulatory.insurance: IRDAI consultation (23-Sep-2026) on capping commissions for loan-linked insurance: Poonawalla's cross-sell income was ₹91 cr in Q1FY27 (~4% of revenue); split by product not disclosed.

ownership.note: The QIP (Apr-2026) moved ~5pp from the promoter to institutions: mutual funds 5.06% → 11.22% in a year. Shareholders 1,90,484 (2,09,209 a year earlier).
ownership.src: Trendlyne (BSE shareholding pattern, Jun-2026); q1ppt p42; Screener.in

critiques: Valuation: ~2.4-2.5x FY28E book for a ~12-14% ROE leaves little margin of safety
Credit cost still ~2.4-2.5% with write-offs ~2% of AUM; book unseasoned while growing 60%+
ECL coverage thin (~1.5% of loans) for a ~46% unsecured book
Assignment (DA) income lumpy and unsustainable at Q4FY26 levels
More equity needed: another raise likely in FY28E
Multiple growth engines and AI-led underwriting drive ROA to 2.4% and ROE to ~16.5% by FY28E
gaps: Valuation methods and estimates of UBS, Jefferies (July note), ICICI Securities (July note) and Anand Rathi; Jefferies' exact date.
JM Financial's standing view on 30-Sep: we found only its 6-May note (Reduce, ₹410); a later JM note (October, after our date) refers to a previous ₹530 target whose date we could not confirm.
HDFC Securities' October note refers to a previous ₹390 target; we found only its 17/18-Jul note (₹365) dated before 30-Sep.
Consolidated FY22-FY23 P&L on a continuing basis (housing finance consolidated, then discontinued): lender ratios start in FY24.
Product-level AUM for Mar-2025 and Jun-2025 (growth by product); product-level credit costs and stage-3 by product.
Borrowing mix by instrument and lender (the presentation chart is not legible in text, except NCDs ~32%).
Exact Q1FY26 and Q4FY25 credit cost % (read from charts: ~2.7% and ~3.1%).
Net QIP proceeds: ₹2,454 cr is our derivation from the Jun-26 balance sheet (includes any ESOP and OCI movements).
Named holders above 1% in Jun-2025 (for changes), and the QIP allottees.
Split of the 6 new products' profitability; management gives no product ROA.
conflicts: MD start date: the brief we were given said Dec-2024; the annual reports show Arvind Kapil became MD & CEO on 10-Jun-2024 (Abhay Bhutada retired on 9-Jun-2024). We use Jun-2024.
Housing sale timing: the deal was announced in Dec-2022 and closed on 26/27-Jul-2023 (not 2023 announcement).
ROA target date: '3-3.5% in 3 years from the day I joined' (Apr-2025, i.e. ~Jun-2027) vs 'June exit of 2028' (Jul-2026).
EPS FY26: reported basic ₹6.84 (weighted 79.19 cr shares) vs Screener ₹6.67; the model uses year-end shares (80.795 cr).
NIM: company 9.10% (NII incl. fees ÷ average AUM, Q1FY27) vs our 7.0% FY26 (NII excl. fees ÷ average year-end AUM); Motilal Oswal 7.0%.
ROA: company 1.98% on average total assets (Q1FY27); ours on average AUM is similar (~1.9%).
Credit cost basis: company 2.40% (Q1FY27, monthly average AUM) vs 2.34% on average quarter-end AUM.
